lci.text: Vito Quijano de Pasamonte leads a Legion expedition to Ixalan's Core, announcing that a door leads to the resting place of Aclazotz, and he cuts a porter's throat on the obsidian altar to open it.
Bartolomé reveals that Queen Miralda secretly assigned him to learn Vito's true loyalties, and when Vito demands Kellan's blood as a sacrifice, Bartolomé attacks him and Vito breaks his neck.
A guide leads Vito to Aclazotz, chained in gold, and he feeds prisoners to the god, who bites Vito and blesses his followers, transforming them into bat-like monsters.
After Clavileño kills Inti, Huatli kills Vito with his own lance, and he dies asking Aclazotz why he forsook him.
